Anna opened the door to her room. She took off her jacket and flung it on the bed. Lara, Lilith and Lana filed in afterwards. 'Lana, watch the door. Lilith check the balcony' Lara ordered. Anna and her niece sat at the table. 'Its so nice to see you again, Lara. I just wish it was under better circumstances. I should probably let you know why I've called you here. I'm sure you are aware of the recent terrorist activity in Mauritius'.

'Ja, it's been all over the news. Its horrible how they executed those three people'.

Lara gasped. She knew Anna used to have a thing for Charles and they had been good friends for years, she must be devastated. Lara got up to hug and comfort her Aunt. They embraced for a few seconds before Lara returned to her seat.

'So now you want to get revenge? I can't say I ever really saw you as the vengeful type'.

'So, what do you want us to do?'.

Government retaliation

During the lengthy dispute, Blackstock suffered personal hardship. In 2013, then-privacy commissioner Jennifer Stoddart found that two government departments had overstepped in monitoring Blackstock and her personal Facebook account.

Stoddart said the Aboriginal Affairs Department and the Justice Department violated the spirit, if not the intent, of the Privacy Act by compiling information from Blackstock's personal social media page.

Both departments agreed to stop the monitoring, destroy personal information not directly linked to federal policy and set up a new system to ensure such surveillance did not happen again.

Last spring, the Canadian Human Rights Tribunal found that a government official "retaliated" against Blackstock and it awarded her $20,000 for pain and suffering. She donated the money to children's charities.

One can hope that the current party in power will not stoop to such depths, indeed one can hope that regardless of the outcome of this process that the current government will act to rectify the obvious failures of a long line of previous governments.

I can only speculate as to what the Harper Government intended to do with the information it gleaned from Ms. Blackstock's social media streams, but I do not imagine that it was benign.
